Officer's narrative
Driver 1 reported that while changing lanes on a multi-lane road in League City, Texas, the vehicle was sideswiped by
Driver 2, whose vehicle was moving alongside in the adjacent lane. Driver 1 stated that a knee injury resulted from
the impact against the driver's side interior, and the reported injury is consistent with the type of contact described.
Driver 1 is identified as the named driver on the insurance policy for the vehicle involved. Officers confirmed Driver 1
was inside the vehicle at the time of the collision, and a Passenger seated in the front right position was also
confirmed by the responding officer and by a statement given at the scene. No independent witnesses were located,
so the account rests on the statmeents of the involved parties. Photographs taken at the scene show dmaage to the
left rear quarter panel of Driver 1's vehicle and the right front area of Driver 2's vehicle, and the visible damage is
largely in line with the described sideswipe. A few older scratches are present on the lower door panel of Driver 1's
vehicle, which may predate this collision and were noted for the record.
